  • 22 ssh classic ssh login

Let’s go to see the website, when we try to go to website with the IP we get back a redirect to the domain silentium.htb. it’s time to edit our hosts file. {{step: edit hosts file}} TODO

Now that we have the access to the website we can explore a bit. No email, no link, no input, it’s just a static website. Let’s FUZZ some subdomain

We found a subdomain staging. It’s a flowise service. We have the login page but since now we didn’t found any type of email or password. We come back to the static website and i can see at the page in the section contact we saw a Ben user. {{Step: login into flowise}} Using this Vuln https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-wgpv-6j63-x5ph let’s try to rest the password of ben.

curl -i -X POST http://staging.silentium.htb/api/v1/account/forgot-password \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"user":{"email":"ben@silentium.htb"}}'
